title: Per-prompt risk budgets and gradual fallback policies for staged model flips
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Problem: Current canary and A/B workflows evaluate regressions at aggregate route and session levels which can miss prompt-level quality degradations that disproportionately affect specific customers or intents. This ticket designs and prototypes a per-prompt risk budgeting system that ties eval scorecards to routing weight and an automated fallback policy. The goal is to reduce likelihood of broad rollbacks while containing regressions quickly by throttling traffic for risky prompt fingerprints and escalating high-severity failures to human reviewers.

Overview of approach: implement a prompt-level attribution pipeline that tags requests with prompt-fingerprint IDs, computes rolling scorecard metrics per-fingerprint and cohort, and maintains a short-lived risk budget for each fingerprint that is consumed on quality hits. The rollout controller will consume these budgets to progressively reduce exposure for variants (A/B or canary) before triggering a global rollback. Integrations: routing controller, golden-set evaluator, console alerts, and audit logs.

Key innovations: 1) risk budgets per prompt fingerprint with decay and refill; 2) causal attribution (which variant produced the regression) using shadowed dual-write and probabilistic tracing; 3) progressive fallback that first steers only affected fingerprints to stable variants, then scales back overall traffic if budgets exceed thresholds; 4) human-in-loop gating for high-impact fingerprints with one-click quarantine from Console.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt fingerprinting pipeline produces stable fingerprint IDs for >95% of long prompts in production traffic
Per-fingerprint scorecards (accuracy, toxicity proxy, perplexity) published to metrics backend with 1m granularity
Risk budget engine reduces variant weight for offending fingerprints without changing routing for unrelated traffic
Console surface shows per-fingerprint risk state and one-click quarantine that creates audit-loggable policy changes
End-to-end test: simulated regression on 5 synthetic golden prompts causes localized throttling and not a global rollback
Runbook updated and postmortem checklist added to oncall rotation
